emma (product): quick thread: we need a trimmed Optimize Toolkit MVP. incoming asks: per-route batching hints, KV/prefix cache suggestions, model quant profiles, and eval-based alerts. want consensus on must-have vs cut.

oliver (eng): must-have infra: endpoint metadata + safe batching caps. optional: auto-apply.

sana (ml): quant: conservative profiles only (fp16, int8-qx). nightly anchor eval (200 prompts). alerts to email only.

kai (design): UI: recommendation card with Preview CTA and one-line rationale. confidence = low/med/high.

maria (cs): customers prefer recommendations first. one enterprise requests tenant default and audit log.

emma (product): MVP proposal (3 weeks): runtime: metadata, KV flag, static batching; ml: profiles + nightly eval; ux: read-only rec panel + preview; alerts: email when delta >3%. pilot after sign-off.

oliver (eng): canary rule: 5% traffic, 1h observe, rollback on p50 >30% or errors >0.5%.

sana (ml): metrics: perplexity shift + top-k anchor check + 20 human samples per run.

infra-bot: reminder: maintenance window Tue 01:00-03:00 UTC.

emma (product): cuts if delayed: delay paging, delay tenant-default, remove confidence badge. next: oliver/sana list tickets today, kai uploads mock, maria starts pilot outreach. Friday 10am sync.
